maes_5.why: Trigonometry involves the study of relationships between angles and sides of triangles, requiring understanding of sine, cosine, and tangent functions.

maes_7.why: Sketching a curve involves understanding the behavior of functions and their graphical representations, which is part of analytical geometry.

maes_8.why: Working with fractions requires understanding parts of a whole, equivalent fractions, and operations involving fractional numbers.

maes_9.why: Determining missing side lengths in geometric figures often involves using the Pythagorean theorem or properties of similar triangles.
